task_description: Write a method in Dafny to remove duplicate numbers from a given integer array.
specification_response:
Method Signature:
    method RemoveDuplicates(a: array<int>) returns (result: array<int>)
Postconditions_prompt:
    - The result array contains no duplicate elements
    - Every element in the result array was present in the input array
    - The result array maintains the relative order of the first occurrences of each element from the input array
